बिल् {c6c} P., {c10c} U. (बिलति, बेलयति-ते)
To split, cleave, break, divide.

1 A hole, cavity, burrow;
खनन्नाखुबिलं सिंहः… प्राप्नोति नखभंगं हि

.
--2 A gap, pit,
chasm.
--3 An aperture, opening,
outlet.
--4 A cave, hollow.
--5 The
hollow of a dish.
--6 The vagina.
--लः
1 N. of उच्चैःश्रवस्, the horse of
Indra.
--2 A sort of cane.
--Comp.
--ओकस् m. any animal that lives
in holes.
--कारिन् m. a mouse.
--योनि a. of the breed of Bila;
यत्राश्वा बिलयोनयः

.
--वासः
a pole-cat.
--वासिन् (also बिलेवासिन्)
m. a snake.
--शायिन् m. any animal
living in burrows.

1 A pit.
--2 Particularly, a
basin for water round the foot of
a tree (आलवाल).
--3 The plant Asa
Foetida.
--Comp.
--सूः a mother of
ten children.

1 A snake.
--2 A mouse,
rat.
--3 Any animal living in
burrows.
--4 A hare.

बिल्वः A species of tree, Aegle
Marmelos or wood-apple.
--ल्वं
1
The fruit of this tree.
--2 A
particular weight (= one pala).
--Comp.
--दंडः an epithet of Śiva.
--पेशिका,
पेशी the shell of the Bilva fruit.
--वनं a thicket or wood of Bilva
trees.

बिल्वकीया A place planted with
Bilva trees.

बिल्हणः N. of a poet, the author
of the Vikramāṅkadevacarita.

बिल्हण Author of the Mahākāvya
Vikramānkadevacharita and of Caurapañcāśikā. He flourished in
the latter half of the 11th century.
